messages:
amanda: Quick sync — blocked on cross-repo sequencing. SDK PR https://github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/2145 depends on API change https://github.com/redwood/api/pull/9876. Also need a helm chart bump in infra/helm (console) before console can pick up the new image.

arjun: What's the failing test on API? I started looking — integration auth test is flaky after the header rename in runtime. :thinking:

josh: I can review SDK today but won't merge until API is in. Can we do a canary? If API merges first, I can run a staged SDK deploy to staging.

maddy: I can approve API once integration tests are green. CI shows a migration script error:
```
ERROR: migration failed: duplicate key on users.email
```
I'll debug tomorrow AM.

ci-bot: [CI] api PR #9876 — integration-tests: failed (logs: https://ci.redwood.internal/builds/4521) :x:

rachel: I can open a quick helm bump PR for console to pick up the new image tag. Will target the same merge window. cc @josh

arjun: Plan suggestion: (1) fix API test + merge (2) SDK review+merge, run 30m canary on staging (3) merge helmbump + console after canary. Keeps blast radius small. :thumbsup:

josh: queued SDK review now. ping me when API is green. :eyes:

amanda: Summary: arjun -> fix API test, maddy -> re-run/approve when CI green, josh -> review SDK, rachel -> helmbump PR. Target merge window Wed 15:00 PST. I'll post a reminder Tue 09:00. Thanks all. :calendar:
